indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX atlas_source_refs_pkey ON public.atlas_source_refs USING btree (source_ref_key, repo_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_atlas_source_refs_content_hash ON public.atlas_source_refs USING btree (content_hash)
CREATE INDEX idx_atlas_source_refs_parent ON public.atlas_source_refs USING btree (parent_source_ref_key) WHERE (parent_source_ref_key IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_atlas_source_refs_repo_path ON public.atlas_source_refs USING btree (repo_id, relative_path)
CREATE INDEX idx_atlas_source_refs_symbol_kind ON public.atlas_source_refs USING btree (symbol_kind) WHERE (symbol_kind IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: atlas_workspace_source_bindin_repo_id_canonical_source_ref_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (repo_id, canonical_source_ref) REFERENCES atlas_source_refs(repo_id, source_ref_key)

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX atlas_workspace_source_bindin_repo_id_canonical_source_ref__key ON public.atlas_workspace_source_bindings USING btree (repo_id, canonical_source_ref, source_revision, workspace_revision)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX atlas_workspace_source_bindings_pkey ON public.atlas_workspace_source_bindings USING btree (repo_id, workspace_revision, canonical_source_ref)
CREATE INDEX atlas_workspace_source_bindings_source_idx ON public.atlas_workspace_source_bindings USING btree (repo_id, canonical_source_ref, source_revision)
CREATE INDEX atlas_workspace_source_bindings_workspace_idx ON public.atlas_workspace_source_bindings USING btree (repo_id, workspace_revision)
